Abstract interface signature in shared/usage.ts:33 is `recordStage(stage: string, model: string, result: SDKResultFields): void` — required, not optional/defaulted. `bun run typecheck` exits 0; all 7 call sites pass model arguments.
Grep for `@anthropic-ai/`, `@ai-sdk/`, `from 'openai'` in shared/ returns zero matches.

All 7 call sites verified to pass the correct resolved model: planner/planner-revision (resolvedModelPlanner), generator (resolvedModelGenerator), evaluator (resolvedModelEvaluator), documenter (resolvedModelDocumenter), contract-proposal (generator's model), contract-review (evaluator's model).

`formatStageTable` (shared/usage.ts:47-73) is a pure function returning string[]. Each row places the model padded as a left-aligned column immediately after the stage name and before all numeric columns ($cost, tokens, duration).
`aggregateByModel` (shared/usage.ts:79-99) sums tokens and cost correctly. Test verifies inputTokens=600, outputTokens=250, costUsd≈0.06 for the spec scenario.
`aggregateByModel` sorts via `(a, b) => b.costUsd - a.costUsd`. Test asserts ordering: 0.20, 0.10, 0.05.
`printSummary` unconditionally calls `formatModelRollup(aggregateByModel(...))`; with one model the section header and one row are printed. Verified by 'works with a single-model rollup' test.

`deserializeStage` (shared/usage.ts:131-141) defaults missing `model` to 'unknown' in exactly one place. save() rewrites the file with the new shape; verified by 'loading legacy usage.json without model field does not throw'.
Test 'save/load round-trip preserves model for multiple models' verifies models 'alpha', 'beta', 'gamma' are preserved exactly after save+reload.

`serializeStage` (shared/usage.ts:147-157) writes keys in the spec-defined order: stage, model, inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, costUsd, durationMs. Test regex-asserts the order in raw JSON.
Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lint` exit code 0. Two pre-existing biome warnings in contract.ts:152 and documenter.ts:91 are not errors and predate this sprint. No new `any` casts introduced.

`formatStageTable`, `aggregateByModel`, `formatModelRollup` are exported pure functions. Tests in tests/usage.test.ts assert directly on the returned arrays without spinning up trackers, files, or capturing stdout.

Domain-vocabulary names are consistent (`ModelRollupRow`, `aggregateByModel`, `formatStageTable`, `formatModelRollup`, `resolvedModel*`). No copy-paste duplication between formatters. Legacy 'unknown' default lives only in `deserializeStage`. Malformed JSON produces a meaningful 'usage.json could not be parsed' message.
